# includes control sampels from other study
```{r message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(DESeq2)
library(Seurat)
library("textTinyR")
library(tidyverse)
library(ggrepel)

```


```{r function}

make_idents_counts <- function(
    ds,
    idents_choose="seurat_clusters",
    assay_="RNA",
    slot_="counts",
    min_cell_num=200){
        
        Idents(ds) <- idents_choose
        group_names <- unique(Idents(ds))
        reads <- slot(ds, "assays")[[assay_]] %>% slot(slot_)
        reads <- reads[rownames(reads) %>% str_subset(pattern = "[.]",negate = T),]
        sum_counts_ds <- tibble(.rows =  nrow(reads))
        #z=1
        for (i in seq_along(group_names)) {
          #print(colnames(sum_counts_ds))
          print(i)
          i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = group_names[i])
          if (length(i_cells)<min_cell_num) {
            sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=0)
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num))
          # print(paste0(as.character(group_names[i]),"_smaller" , as.character(min_cell_num)))
          # print(i)
            
            #if (z==2) (return(sum_counts_ds))
          #z=z+1
          next}
          #i_cells <- WhichCells(object =ds,idents = "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes_C19-CB-0003")
          sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%
            add_column(dings=reads[,i_cells] %>%  sparse_Sums(rowSums=T))
          colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i] <- as.character(group_names[i])
          #print(as.character(colnames(sum_counts_ds)[i]))
          
        }
        #colnames(sum_counts_ds) <- group_names
        sum_counts_ds <- sum_counts_ds %>%  mutate(gene=rownames(reads)) %>% relocate(gene)
        return(sum_counts_ds)
}

```
```{r}
path_data_file <- paste0(here::here("..", "..", "raw_data", "schulte_schrepping_et_al"), "/")
path_output_file <- ".\\output\\"
```

```{r}
seurat_monocytes <-  read_rds(paste0(path_data_file,
                                     "schulte_schrepping_monocytes_from_seurat_COVID19_PBMC_cohort1_10x_jonas_FG_2020-08-15.rds"))

seurat_monocytes$cluster_donor <- paste0(seurat_monocytes$cluster_clean, "__",seurat_monocytes$donor)
tibble(cluster=seurat_monocytes$cluster_clean,donor=seurat_monocytes$donor ) %>% group_by(cluster,donor) %>% summarise(n=n()) %>% filter(n>49)
```
```{r}
ds_monocytes <-  make_idents_counts(seurat_monocytes, idents_choose = "cluster_donor")
ds_monocytes %>% write_rds( paste0(path_output_file,"bulk_sums_monocytes.rds") )
ds_monocytes %>% select(!(contains("_smaller"))) 
ds_monocytes %>% select(contains("_smaller")) 
```

```{r}
x <- ds_monocytes %>% select(!(contains("_smaller"))) %>% ungroup()
expression_matrix <- as.matrix(x %>% select(-gene)) 
rownames(expression_matrix) <- x %>% pull(gene)
```


```{r}
design_x <-colnames(expression_matrix)%>% 
  tibble(dings=.) %>% separate(col= dings,into = c("cell_type","donor"),sep = "__") %>%mutate_all(as_factor)
design_x
reihenfolge <- paste0(design_x$cell_type,"__", design_x$donor)
expression_matrix <- expression_matrix[,reihenfolge]

```

##takes looong

```{r eval=FALSE, include=FALSE}
# what does this do

clusters <- unique(design_x$cell_type)
res_list <- vector(mode="list", length = length(clusters))
for (cluster in clusters) {
  design_cluster <- design_x %>% mutate(cell_type=fct_other(cell_type,keep = cluster))
  print(design_cluster)
  flush.console()
  res_list[[cluster]]<- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(expression_matrix,
                              colData=design_cluster,
                              design= ~  cell_type+ donor ) %>% DESeq()
  
}

write_rds(res_list, paste0(path_output_file,"deseq_monocytes_results.rds"))
```

```{r}
res_list <- read_rds(paste0(path_output_file,"deseq_monocytes_results.rds"))

res_hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes <- results( res_list[["hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes"]], 
                                          contrast= c("cell_type", "hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")

res_non_classical_monocytes<- results( res_list$non_classical_monocytes, 
                                          contrast= c("cell_type", "non_classical_monocytes", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")

res_classical_monocytes<- results( res_list$classical_monocytes, 
                                          contrast= c("cell_type", "classical_monocytes", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")

res_hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes<- results( res_list$hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes, 
                                          contrast= c("cell_type", "hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")

res_cd163hi_monocytes_1_d7<- results( res_list$cd163hi_monocytes_1_d7, 
                                          contrast= c("cell_type", "cd163hi_monocytes_1_d7", "Other")) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "gene")


res_hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_hla_d_rlo_s100a_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange<0) %>% arrange(pvalue)

res_non_classical_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_non_classical_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange<0) %>% arrange(pvalue)


res_classical_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_hla_d_rhi_cd83_monocytes %>% filter(log2FoldChange<0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
res_cd163hi_monocytes_1_d7 %>% filter(log2FoldChange>0) %>% arrange(pvalue)
```
